rules.title: Clan tag
rules.content: Players have to wear our tag, except when the management ackknowledged and agreed.

rules.title: Respect
rules.content: Every member is treaded with respect regardless of the situation.

rules.title: Authority
rules.content: Management has the saying in decisions and members need to follow them. Rules are consistently enforced.

rules.title: Sabotaging
rules.content: Game-sabotating intentionally will not be tolerated (like team-attacking, blocking team-mates etc)

rules.title: Compliance
rules.content: Adherence to Game/ Platform TOS: Members must follow the terms of service of the games they play and the platforms they use.

rules.title: Cheating
rules.content: Cheating in any way (software cheat, stream sniping...) is not allowed. Stay fair and show sportsmanship

rules.title: Spam
rules.content: Excessive spam is not tolerated (weather on the server, chat...)

rules.title: Language
rules.content: We all get frustrated and vent sometimes, but abusive language or flame is not tolerated.

rules.title: Publicity
rules.content: We also don't disrespect other players or teams that dont belong to us. That also means no public drama

rules.title: Voice comms
rules.content: Communication is key, so we expect from every member to show up in voice chat. Use appropriate language

rules.title: Confidentiality
rules.content: Intern knowledge like map tricks or community creations may only be shared in an agreement

rules.title: Schedulings
rules.content: Members have to sign off on import calendar dates

rules.title: Transparency
rules.content: We always try to be as democratic and transparent as possible. Only trial members have no saying in team decisions

rules.title: Rejoins
rules.content: Rejoining the team is possible after a reviewing process

rules.title: Multi Memberships
rules.content: Joining other teams is not allowed without the management consent

rules.title: Inactivity
rules.content: Permanently inactive players that didn't give sign-off notice are removed

rules.title: Avoiding topics
rules.content: There will be no tolerance on religious or political topics

rules.title: Sexism
rules.content: Female gamers are to be respected

rules.title: Racism
rules.content: We have members from all over the world and want to be an open an communicative place for everyone, no matter the origins or ethnicity of someone

rules.title: Main principles
rules.content:
In the end we live by three main principles

Trust. Be honest to everyone. Nenver deceiving and always beliebing members. Admitting mistakes is ok.
Honor. Always harbor good feelings and uplifting behavior towards each other. We are here to bring you up, not take you down.
Respect. Accept the fellow members for who they are. Everyone wants to be treated a certain way.
